newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Honduras 97 sugar crop ends at 5.3 mln 100-lb bags.
newsitem.headline: Honduras 97 sugar crop ends at 5.3 mln 100-lb bags.

text.p: Honduras produced 5.3 million 100-lb bags (around 240,900 tonnes) of sugar in 1997, 500,000 bags (22,730 tonnes) more than last year, National Association of Sugar Producers said Wednesday.
President Sergio Salinas said the increase in output came from improved cane growing conditions and an increase in the installed capacity of the country's mills.

Next year, Salinas said the country's eight mills would see an output similar or slightly above this year. But he said yields would probably be down in the next cycle, although he gave no explanation.
Salinas said 900,000 bags (around 40,900 tonnes) would be exported this year from the crop. He gave no details of exports to date, or pending shipments.
